name: Raise default Bash timeout to 1 hour
description: Raises the default Bash tool timeout fallback (used when BASH_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS env var is unset or invalid) from 120000 ms (2 minutes) to 3600000 ms (1 hour, written as 3600e3 for same byte length). Affects getDefaultBashTimeoutMs(). Lets long-running Bash commands complete without being killed at 2 minutes by default.

operations.rationale: getDefaultBashTimeoutMs returns the literal 120000 (DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS = 120_000) when the env override is absent. Anchoring on the stable BASH_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS string plus the surrounding parse/return structure (with churned minified identifiers captured generically) pins the exact call site uniquely. Only the trailing numeric literal is rewritten; 3600e3 is valid JS scientific notation (3,600,000) and is exactly the same byte length as 120000, so the CJS module stays parseable and no offsets shift.
